name: Wolf
intro: A wolf is a wild animal in the dog family. Wolves live and hunt together in family groups.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A wolf looks like a big dog.
It has long legs and a bushy tail.
Its fur can be gray, brown, black, or white.
It is the biggest wild animal in the dog family.
Males are bigger than females.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Wolves live in North America, Europe, and Asia.
Many wolves live in Alaska and Canada.
They can live where it is very cold or very hot.
Each pack has its own home area called a territory.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Wolves eat meat.
They hunt big animals like deer, elk, and moose.
The pack hunts together as a team.
A wolf can eat as much meat as a big turkey in one meal.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A baby wolf is called a pup.
Pups are born in a den.
At first, pups cannot see or hear.
Older brothers and sisters help feed and play with the pups.
Young wolves stay with their parents for at least two years.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Every wolf pack has its own howl.
A howl can be heard miles away.
Wolves bow to ask another wolf to play.
A wolf's nose smells much better than yours.
Wolves and dogs are close relatives.

vocab.meaning: A long, loud call that wolves make.
The home area where an animal lives and finds food.
